messages:
sara: Quick FYI — drafting release notes for tomorrow's deploy. Need known-issues, snippet check, and a short migration note for SDK v1.6.0. Using this thread to coordinate.

alex: Got it. I have PR #482 in the docs repo with the SDK snippet updates. Will review phrasing and examples.

julie: I'll double-check the Python and Node examples for the function-calling/streaming change. Found one broken snippet in node/sdk.md (async/await + streaming) :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

kevin: @julie can you paste the snippet line that fails? I can push a tiny patch.

julie: Snippet: ```js const res = await client.responses.create({ model: 'kestrel', input: 'hi' }) // missing .stream handler when streaming true``` — that's what tripped local example.

kevin: Thanks. I'll push a quick fix to #482 and add a changelog blurb about the streaming signature change.

docs-bot: deploybot: preview build for #482 is up — https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai (expires in 48h).

matt: Known issue to call out: embedding endpoint can return partial results for payloads > ~1MB. We should add a known-issues entry with recommended workaround (chunk + retry). Who can write it?

olivia: I can draft the workaround blurb and include a short curl example.

olivia: curl example: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"input": "<chunked-data>"}'
``` — will add pseudocode for chunking + backoff.

sara: Please also add a one-paragraph migration note for Dedicated customers about model pinning/fallback order change — keep it concise and non-technical.

alex: Will add that. Also planning a quick link sweep — a few guides still reference the old `/beta-console` path. I'll run a grep and open fixes.

kevin: Any downstream SDK reference links to update? e.g., JS docs linking to old endpoint names.

julie: Yep — node/sdk.md and quickstart/embedding.md. I'll mark TODOs in the PR and add inline comments for reviewers.

matt: Also include a short callout in the relnotes for improved batching cost estimates — one bullet + link to Optimize guide.

sara: :thumbsup: ok. Final ask — can someone QA the release-note copy for tone? Prefer developer-first, concise bullets.

alex: I’ll do a pass in the morning. ETA ~10:30am PT.

docs-bot: ci:relnotes-lint job failed on #482 — broken link: 404 at /docs/beta-console -> recommended replace with /console.

kevin: I'll fix that link right now.

sara: Great — once fixes are merged, aim to ship by EOD. If anything blocks, ping #docs-release-channel and escalate. Thanks everyone!
